en:browserExt.checker.settingsLine.text: Turning this on sends your task and the page details to Flux to check browser actions.
en:browserExt.checker.settingsLine.en: Turning this on sends your task and the page details to Flux to check browser actions.
en:browserExt.checker.settingsLine.note: Clearly states the enabling condition, both data categories, Flux as recipient, and browser-action checking purpose.

de:browserExt.checker.settingsLine.text: Wenn du dies einschaltest, werden deine Aufgabe und die Seitendetails an Flux gesendet, um Browseraktionen zu prüfen.
de:browserExt.checker.settingsLine.en: Turning this on sends your task and the page details to Flux to check browser actions.
de:browserExt.checker.settingsLine.note: Faithful, clear translation; both Aufgabe and Seitendetails are explicitly sent to Flux for checking browser actions.

fr:browserExt.checker.settingsLine.text: Activer cette option envoie ta tâche et les détails de la page à Flux pour vérifier les actions du navigateur.
fr:browserExt.checker.settingsLine.en: Turning this on sends your task and the page details to Flux to check browser actions.
fr:browserExt.checker.settingsLine.note: Clear translation with consistent informal address; preserves the complete disclosure.
